title: The Leg
question: What's its everyday name?
lines: The longest, strongest bone in your body is in the thigh.
Watch the long bone that's glowing above the knee.
What's the everyday name of this bone?
The shinbone is below the knee, not above it.
This one runs from the hip down to the knee.
It's B. The thighbone, or femur.
Why it matters: it carries your weight with every step.

title: The Leg
question: Which bone is glowing?
lines: Two bones run below your knee. Which one is glowing?
Watch the thicker bone at the front of the lower leg.
Which bone is glowing?
The fibula is the thin one beside it, and it bears little weight.
This thicker bone carries your body weight down to the ankle.
It's D. The tibia, or shinbone.
Why it matters: you can feel it just under the skin of your shin.

title: The Leg
question: Which bone is glowing?
lines: The largest bone in your foot is at the back.
Watch the glowing bone under the ankle.
Which bone is glowing?
The talus sits on top of it and joins the shin bones.
The glowing bone forms your heel.
It's B. The calcaneus, or heel bone.
Why it matters: it takes your weight every time your heel hits the ground.

title: The Leg
question: Which side of the shin is it on?
lines: Your lower leg has two bones side by side.
Watch the thin glowing bone beside the shin.
Which side of the shin is it on?
The inner bone is the thick tibia, the shinbone.
This thinner one is the fibula, on the outer side of the leg.
It's A. The outer side. That's the fibula.
Why it matters: the fibula carries much less weight than the tibia.

title: The Leg
question: How many bones are in the lower leg?
lines: Below the knee, the leg is not just one bone.
Watch the glowing bones between the knee and the ankle.
How many bones are in the lower leg?
People often think of only the shinbone.
There is the thick tibia and the thin fibula beside it.
It's C. Two bones.
Why it matters: the tibia carries most of the body weight.

title: The Leg
question: What's its everyday name?
lines: There's a small bone at the front of your knee.
Watch the little glowing bone in front of the knee joint.
What's its everyday name?
The shinbone is the long bone below the knee, not this one.
The glowing bone is the patella.
It's D. The kneecap.
Why it matters: it helps the thigh muscle pull the lower leg straight.

title: The Leg
question: How many metatarsals are in a foot?
lines: The long bones in the middle of your foot come in a set.
Watch the glowing bones between the ankle and the toes.
How many metatarsals are in a foot?
Seven is the number of tarsal bones in the ankle and heel.
One long bone runs to each toe.
It's B. Five.
Why it matters: they form the arch and the ball of your foot.
